slides.title: Steady, not a sprint.
slides.body: Strict press first. Then 14 minutes you can hold.

slides.title: 6 to 8 rounds.
slides.body: About two minutes a round. Same split every round.

slides.title: Pull-ups to failure early.
slides.body: Break them 4 and 4 from round one, before you have to.

slides.title: Ring rows, lighter bells.
slides.body: Keep moving. Fewer reps beat long stalls at the bar.
